verdict.rationale: Ramp documents employee reimbursement requests on web or mobile (snap a receipt, add a memo, submit), with payout "in two days or less" in local currency across 70+ countries. Employees can also submit via the CLI (reimbursements list/pending/submit) and via MCP. Pending and paid reimbursement states are implied by CLI commands and the sandbox's "mark reimbursement as paid" action. missing for 10: explicit confirmation that payout is by direct deposit/bank transfer, documented employee-facing status tracking from submission through payout, independent or hands-on corroboration.
